21:   if (!fs.existsSync(contentDir)) return [];
22: 
23:   const files: string[] = [];
24:   const walk = (dir: string): void => {
25:     for (const entry of fs.readdirSync(dir, { withFileTypes: true })) {
26:       const full = path.join(dir, entry.name);
27:       if (entry.isDirectory()) {
28:         walk(full);
29:       } else if (entry.isFile() && MARKDOWN_EXTENSION.test(entry.name)) {
30:         files.push(full);
31:       }
32:     }
33:   };
34:   walk(contentDir);
35:   return files.sort();
36: }

38: export function slugFor(filePath: string, contentDir: string): string {
39:   const relative = path.relative(contentDir, filePath).replace(/\\/g, '/');
40:   return relative.replace(MARKDOWN_EXTENSION, '');
41: }

part.text:
Added template engine and layout support to the SSG.

**What changed:**
